finding.detail: behavior.class states 'Profile exact Native/SharedAccess'. maintenance/Program.cs:11-12 (and WebHostSetup:25) uses case-sensitive Enum.TryParse plus Enum.IsDefined, but does not compare original text with profile.ToString(). Unlike LocalLogin's exact role check, these checks do not exclude numeric representations of defined enum values or parsing whitespace. State the parsed/defined enum condition rather than an exact textual allowlist. The supported profiles/objects and catalog count do not change.

behavior.forms says 'Deleted/expired detail yields404'. Original coordinator.Edit throws 404 when GetAsync returns null (including deleted/missing student), whereas EditorSnapshotStore.Get explicitly throws 409 for a missing/expired snapshot; SearchContextStore.Get likewise uses 409 for missing/expired search state. There is no timed student-detail expiry branch producing 404. Keep these exceptional conditions separate; behavior.context already correctly records 409 for search expiry.
